full_prompt_en: A dark, painterly portrait composition shows a grey-haired man with round glasses seated among ornate frames and fantastic carved forms. The background is a dense brown-black field of small pictures, decorative mouldings and shadowed recesses. Across the upper left, an enormous weathered creature-like carving arches over the chair, its long textured snout curving downward beside a tall patterned panel. A small horizontal framed scene occupies the upper middle. The man fills the central area from head to lower chest, seated in a carved chair with a narrow red upholstered section visible behind his left shoulder. His body turns slightly toward the right, while his face and pale eyes look outward through round black-rimmed spectacles. Soft grey hair falls across his forehead, and a full pale beard and moustache frame closed lips and a serious expression. He wears a dark teal-black coat over a similarly dark buttoned layer, with subtle vertical fabric texture and a small pale triangle at the neck. Near the lower right, one hand rests across the cream pages of an open book, partly hidden by foreground frames. Down the right side, two large framed female portraits sit above a smaller image of a dark winged creature. Along the left edge, a narrow picture contains a standing bearded figure, while a larger lower portrait shows a person wearing rounded headgear. Across the bottom, a small female profile, a square image of a snarling fantastic face and a narrow male portrait overlap the main figure's lower body. Their aged bronze and gold frames have varied carved borders and dark recesses. Soft warm light from the upper left catches the man's forehead, beard, hand and selected frame edges, while muted green undertones remain in the deep shadows. The overall composition encloses a calm central sitter within layered portraits and elaborate grotesque ornament, balancing pale skin and paper against aged metallic highlights and heavy darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅深暗的绘画式肖像构图表现一位戴圆眼镜的灰发男子坐在华丽画框和奇幻雕饰之间。背景由小画、装饰线脚与阴影凹处组成密集棕黑色域。左上方巨大的风化兽形雕饰拱过椅子，带纹理的长吻部在高装饰板旁向下弯曲。上方中央有一幅横向小框画。男子从头部到下胸占据中央，坐在雕花椅中，左肩后露出窄窄红色软包。他的身体略朝右，面部与浅色双眼透过黑框圆眼镜朝向观者。柔软灰发垂过额头，浓密浅色胡须与上唇胡围着闭合嘴唇，神情严肃。他穿深青黑外套，内层同样深色并带纽扣，织物有细微竖纹，颈边露出一小块浅色三角形。右下附近，一只手搭在摊开书本的奶油色书页上，部分被前景画框遮住。沿右侧，两幅较大的女性肖像下方排列着一幅深色有翼生物小画。左边缘窄画里是一位站立蓄须人物，左下较大肖像表现戴圆拢头盔状头饰的人。底部一幅小女性侧脸、一幅方形龇牙奇幻面孔及一幅窄男性肖像与主角下身交叠。古旧青铜和金色画框边缘雕纹不同，凹处深暗。左上柔暖光照到男子额头、胡须、手以及部分框边，深影中保留暗绿色底调。整体构图以层叠肖像和繁复怪诞装饰围住平静的中央坐像，让浅肤色、纸页与旧金属亮边平衡厚重暗部。
style_prompt_en: The painterly cinematic treatment combines a sharply resolved focal area with densely layered, softly recessed detail. Charcoal, deep teal and warm brown form the shadow structure, accented by muted bronze, aged gold and small cream highlights. Fine surface grain, carved-looking repetitions and worn metallic edges enrich the darker fields without equalizing their contrast. Nested rectangles and curving ornamental forms create an enclosing rhythm around a more open centre. Selective warm light reveals raised edges and pale surfaces, leaving deep recesses cool and indistinct. The overall effect is intimate and enigmatic, with tactile decorative complexity held together by controlled light and strong tonal hierarchy.
style_prompt_zh: 带电影感的绘画处理将清晰焦点与密集层叠、柔和退后的细节结合。炭灰、深青和暖棕组成阴影结构，暗青铜、旧金色与小片奶油亮色作点缀。细微表面颗粒、雕刻般重复纹理及磨损金属边缘丰富暗色域，却不让所有局部反差一样强。嵌套长方形和弯曲装饰形体在较开阔中央周围形成围合节奏。选择性暖光揭示凸起边缘和浅色表面，深凹处则保持冷暗模糊。整体效果亲近而神秘，以受控光线和明确明度层级将可感的繁复装饰统一起来。
theme_en: A grey-haired man with round glasses sits among ornate framed portraits and fantastic carved forms, holding an open book
theme_zh: 灰发圆眼镜男子坐在华丽相框肖像与奇幻雕饰之间，手扶摊开的书
name: Guillermo del Toro
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
